purpose: Show that even a basic threshold is unmet, let alone a greater one.
keywords: Greater item + はおろか + lesser item + も / さえ + negative
I cannot read hiragana yet, let alone kanji.
I cannot afford to eat out, let alone travel.
I cannot wait ten minutes, let alone an hour.
formation: Greater item + はおろか + lesser item + も / さえ + negative
restrictions: The second item is normally easier or more basic.
mistake: Keep the scale in order so the let-alone contrast makes sense.
